test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of the adverb of frequency.**

options.text: Radha goes to Nagpur with great affection.
Radha goes to Nagpur for her office work.
Radha goes to Nagpur to meet her uncle.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Radha often goes to Nagpur.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The adverb of frequency shows how frequently an action takes place.
 
• **Often **is an adverb meaning 'many times on different occasions'.
 
• The adverb "**often**" is commonly used with the simple present tense.
 
• It is used in the front position, in the mid position between the subject and the main verb, after the modal verb or first auxiliary verb, or after being as a main verb or in the end position.
 
 
• **For example-** *I often see Christine when I'm in town.*
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Radha frequently visits Nagpur.
 
• So, it is clear that '**often**' implies an action that happens frequently but it is not regular.
 
• Therefore, "**often**" should be used in the sentence.

Hence, the correct sentence with the appropriate use of the adverb of frequency is written in **option 3.**
